messages:
julia: FYI pasted the RFP from NimbleHealth into the thread + attached the PDF. They want a capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, and a POC timeline. Can we sync on who owns which pieces?

julia: Key asks - onprem/HSM options, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data residency (EU), and a 30-day POC with production-ish load. Also asked for a balloon pricing range for hosted vs dedicated.

vikram: I can own the capability matrix and model/latency profile. Will pull our Dedicated vs Hosted feature rows.

vikram: Quick Q: do they need HSM for keywrap or full crypto at rest? That changes Private packaging. @sarah can you confirm required control level?

sarah: They listed "HSM for key management" in SecReq #4 and want SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. I'll take the questionnaire and start a redline of our answers.

marcus: For pricing - rough bands only for RFP: Hosted API: $0.0025 - $0.007 / gen-token depending on model tier. Dedicated: $20k-$80k/mo for baseline pool sizes (depends on GPU class & sustained QPS). Add a note: annual commit 10-20% discount usually. This is not final, just a ballpark for the RFP.

marcus: Also call out optional add-ons: observability retention, private control plane (one-time setup), and HSM integration (professional services + infra).

vikram: I'm assembling the capability matrix. Skeleton rows: model catalog, streaming, kv-prefix caching, canary rollouts, quantization support, HSM/KMS, VPC peering, SSO, audit logs, SLA.

vikram: Putting a short compatibility note: if they require HSM-backed keywrap for model weights at rest in Private, our on-prem package + HSM is recommended — Hosted can integrate with customer KMS via broker but not full on-prem HSM.

sarah: Security questionnaire: I'll answer all standard items but flag anything that needs legal signoff (e.g., subprocessor list, data transfer / DPA exceptions).

julia: POC timeline proposal (draft):
```
Week 0: scoping + account setup (credentials, region)
Week 1: baseline deployment + model pin + smoke tests
Week 2: synthetic load + latency tuning (batching/quant)
Week 3: pilot with sample traffic + metrics review
Week 4: handover + runbook + cost projection
```
Please comment if that timeline looks tight for a 30-day POC.

vikram: Timeline looks good. We'll need 2 GPU nodes reserved for Dedicated POC. I'll note required capacity in the matrix.

marcus: One other enterprise blocker to call out in the RFP response: customer requires 99.95% region-specific uptime and an on-call escalation policy. We should say: supported via Dedicated SLA + optional multi-region fallback for Hosted.

sarah: I've started filling the questionnaire and uploaded a redline to the thread: https://redwood.internal/docs/rfi/nimble-health/sec-qna-draft.pdf (please review).

julia: Nice. Action items: vikram -> capability matrix (due EOD Tue). marcus -> pricing bands + POC cost estimate (EOD Tue). sarah -> sec questionnaire redline + list of docs to attach (SOC2, ISO certs) (Wed morning). I'll assemble final zip and attach to RFP response.

vikram: Added a comment in the matrix: include example perf numbers for "chat, 8k context" and "embeddings 512d" per their use case.

marcus: I'll also draft a one-paragraph "assumptions" section for the pricing: sustained QPS, sequence length, retention, and expected token mix.

securitybot: Reminder: don't attach internal PII in responses. Use sanitized screenshots.

julia: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll send the draft to Sales leadership for sign-off Thurs AM and upload final to the RFP portal by EOD Thu.

vikram: No objections from me.

sarah: Looks good. I'll prioritize the questionnaire redline.

marcus: 👍 I'll get the cost numbers over later today.

julia: Great — closing the loop here. I'll post the assembled ZIP to the RFP portal link once we have all pieces.
